name: Suzukaze (涼風, "Cool Breeze")
concept: A Solarian-class Frame whose melee Strikes are reflavored as a building-scale weapon that flares like caught light on the upswing — a strange match for Etsuko's stillness on paper, until you notice both of them only move when they mean it.
notes: DRAFT — proposed 2026-08-22 at Ingram's direct request, open to full revision. Grounded in GM Core pg. 121-124's real level-12 tables: AC Moderate (32), attack bonus Moderate (+24) paired deliberately with Strike damage Extreme (3d12+19, avg 38) — a striker archetype the guidance explicitly calls out ('a creature could have a higher attack bonus and lower damage, or vice versa'), traded accuracy for real burst. Saves Fort High(25)/Reflex Moderate(22)/Will Low(19), HP Moderate tier (215) — GM Core's own note that extreme AC and high HP shouldn't stack together, so a striker leans lighter on both. One signature Strike only, same scope precedent as every other Frame in this batch — see kurogane.json's notes for the fuller reasoning.
